registration.summary: 求 (by+ax) 的 k 次方中指定项的系数，模 10007。x、y 的指数分别为 n、m，均非负且 n+m=k。k 至多1000，a、b 均为不超过1000000的非负数。组合 C(k,n) 与两个幂即可。模数为素数且 k 小于模数，满足阶乘逆元前提；零次幂按空乘积为1。

oracle: Literal polynomial multiplication for exhaustive small cases; exact math.comb and Python modular powers for boundaries/random cases; complete k=1000 Pascal row cross-checked with exact math.comb. No C++ factorial/inverse oracle.
scope: Single legal P1313 instance per invocation, exact one-line output. Local checks only; no online AC, full-suite, performance or LSan claim. Canonical 1 1 3 1 2 is hand-checked, not asserted to be an official sample.
